introduction: This chrome-plated tape measure is a differentiated option for buyers who need a polished case finish alongside practical OEM branding and packaging choices. It is suitable for hardware, gift-tool and retail programs where shelf presentation matters.

The supplied material shows a 5m configuration. Before sampling, confirm the required tape length, blade width, scale system, logo position, packaging and target market so the factory can match the correct build.
For an accurate quotation, send your logo file, required quantity, destination market and packaging reference. We will confirm the available configuration and inspection points before production.

faq.question: Can the chrome-plated tape measure carry a private-label logo?
faq.answer: Yes. Case logo or label artwork, packaging artwork, barcode and carton mark can be reviewed for the selected configuration.

faq.question: What tape length is shown for this model?
faq.answer: The supplied product material shows a 5m configuration. Confirm final length, blade width and scale layout with the RFQ.

faq.question: Can the blade use metric or inch markings?
faq.answer: Metric, imperial or dual-unit marking directions can be reviewed according to the production configuration and destination market.

faq.question: What should be checked before a bulk order?
faq.answer: Approve the plated finish, logo, blade printing, lock and retraction, hook, packaging and carton information on the sample.
